description: This file defines an asynchronous function 'createModeInstructions' that generates instructions for configuring custom modes in a VSCode extension. It imports modules for path handling, VSCode API, and project-specific utilities, then constructs a multi-line string with guidelines for creating and managing modes, including required and optional fields, and YAML structure.

methods.name: createModeInstructions
